desc: Implement segment tree class with Node(sum, pref, suff, best) supporting build, point update, and whole-tree query.
In Solution.maxSubarraySum, build the tree from nums, compute original max via Kadane (or tree.best) as baseline.
Build a mapping value -> list of indices for all distinct values in nums.
For each value v, if it occupies all positions skip; otherwise temporarily set its indices to 0 via tree updates, update answer with tree.best, then restore original values via tree updates.
